**Never:**
- Re-seed a canary only on a CONFIRMED upstream change, never to make a run pass.
- Never pass --allow-shrink without finding out why the source shrank.

**Known failures:**
- `/canary/i`: The АОП / ЦАИС feed changed shape: fix the parser and re-seed its fixture from the new upstream.
- `/Unrecogni[sz]ed\w*Error/`: An OCDS label the parser does not know: add it to the label table — an unreadable label must throw, never map to a guess.
- `/\b403\b/`: data.egov.bg answered 403: not a dead portal; the geo merge keeps the previous tier — re-run later.
